title: Farmers stage protests; seek waiver of loans

ai.summary: Farmers in north Karnataka staged protests demanding state government waive agricultural loans from cooperative banks, citing a recent poll promise.

facts.claim: Farmers across 35 districts under the Tamizhaga Vivasayigal Padhukappu Sangam staged a protest demanding that the State government waive agricultural loans in cooperative banks.
facts.quote: Farmers across 35 districts under the Tamizhaga Vivasayigal Padhukappu Sangam staged a protest demanding that the State government waive agricultural loans in cooperative banks.

facts.claim: Members of the 50 associations led by Easan Murugasamy said that farmers were only reminding the TVK government of its poll promise of complete waiver of farm loans.
facts.quote: Members of the 50 associations led by Easan Murugasamy said that farmers were only reminding the TVK government of its poll promise of complete waiver of farm loans.

facts.claim: The government had recently urged farmers to repay their loans availed at cooperative banks by November 30, so that they may avail fresh loans from December 1.
facts.quote: The government had recently urged farmers to repay their loans availed at cooperative banks by November 30, so that they may avail fresh loans from December 1.

ai.background_note: Farmers in north Karnataka demanded state government waive agricultural loans from cooperative banks, citing a recent poll promise.
